from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
import json
import re

base = Path('/Users/ab/Projects/php-ai-toolkit/packages/docgen-php')
src = base / 'src'
moves = {}
def move(old, new):
    moves[Path('DocGen') / old] = Path('DocGen') / new

for p in (src / 'DocGen/Analysis/Model').glob('*.php'):
    move('Analysis/Model/' + p.name, 'Model/Symbol/' + p.name)
move('Analysis/Parse/FileSymbols.php', 'Model/Symbol/FileSymbols.php')
move('Analysis/ProjectModel.php', 'Model/ProjectModel.php')
for name in ['HierarchyIndex', 'SymbolTable', 'TestCase', 'TestCaseIndex', 'Usage', 'UsageIndex']:
    move('Analysis/Reference/' + name + '.php', 'Model/Reference/' + name + '.php')
for name in ['CoverageIndex', 'MethodCoverage']:
    move('Analysis/Coverage/' + name + '.php', 'Model/Coverage/' + name + '.php')
for name in ['LayerCollector', 'LayerDefinition', 'LayerModel']:
    move('Analysis/Layer/' + name + '.php', 'Model/Layer/' + name + '.php')
for name in ['ComposerManifest', 'DiscoveredPackage', 'PackageDependency', 'PackageGraph']:
    move('Package/' + name + '.php', 'Model/Package/' + name + '.php')
for p in (src / 'DocGen/Analysis/Diff').glob('*.php'):
    directory = 'Execution' if p.stem in ['DiffWorkspace', 'DiffSession'] else 'Diff'
    move('Analysis/Diff/' + p.name, directory + '/' + p.name)
for p in (src / 'DocGen/Analysis/Doctest').glob('*.php'):
    move('Analysis/Doctest/' + p.name, 'Render/Doctest/' + p.name)
move('Analysis/ProjectAnalyzer.php', 'Execution/ProjectAnalyzer.php')
move('DocGenException.php', 'Diagnostic/DocGenException.php')

classes = {}
by_namespace = defaultdict(list)
for p in src.rglob('*.php'):
    rel = p.relative_to(src)
    new = moves.get(rel, rel)
    old_name = 'Toolkit\\' + str(rel.with_suffix('')).replace('/', '\\')
    new_name = 'Toolkit\\' + str(new.with_suffix('')).replace('/', '\\')
    classes[old_name] = new_name
    by_namespace[old_name.rsplit('\\', 1)[0]].append((p.stem, new_name))

changed = {old: new for old, new in classes.items() if old != new}
pattern = re.compile(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])(?:' + '|'.join(re.escape(n) for n in sorted(changed, key=len, reverse=True)) + r')(?![A-Za-z0-9_\\])')
json_pattern = re.compile('|'.join(re.escape(n.replace('\\', '\\\\')) for n in sorted(changed, key=len, reverse=True)) + r'(?![A-Za-z0-9_])')

for root in [src, base / 'tests']:
    for p in list(root.rglob('*.php')):
        original = p.read_text()
        text = pattern.sub(lambda m: changed[m.group()], original)
        text = json_pattern.sub(lambda m: changed[m.group().replace('\\\\', '\\')].replace('\\', '\\\\'), text)
        namespace = re.search(r'^namespace ([^;]+);', original, re.M)
        dest = p
        if root == src:
            rel = p.relative_to(src)
            dest = src / moves.get(rel, rel)
            old_ns = namespace.group(1)
            new_ns = 'Toolkit\\' + str(dest.parent.relative_to(src)).replace('/', '\\')
            text = text.replace('namespace ' + old_ns + ';', 'namespace ' + new_ns + ';')
            imports = []
            for name, new_name in by_namespace[old_ns]:
                if name == p.stem or new_name.rsplit('\\', 1)[0] == new_ns:
                    continue
                if re.search(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_\\])' + re.escape(name) + r'\b', original) and not re.search(r'^use [^;]+\\' + re.escape(name) + r';$', text, re.M):
                    imports.append('use ' + new_name + ';')
            if p.stem == 'ProjectAnalyzer':
                text = text.replace('list<Model\\ClassLikeDoc>', 'list<ClassLikeDoc>')
                imports.append('use Toolkit\\DocGen\\Model\\Symbol\\ClassLikeDoc;')
            if imports:
                text = text.replace('namespace ' + new_ns + ';', 'namespace ' + new_ns + ';\n\n' + '\n'.join(imports))
        elif p.is_relative_to(base / 'tests/Unit'):
            rel = p.relative_to(base / 'tests/Unit')
            source_rel = rel.with_name(rel.name.removesuffix('Test.php') + '.php')
            if source_rel in moves:
                new_rel = moves[source_rel]
                dest = base / 'tests/Unit' / new_rel.with_name(new_rel.stem + 'Test.php')
                new_ns = 'Tests\\Unit\\' + str(dest.parent.relative_to(base / 'tests/Unit')).replace('/', '\\')
                text = text.replace('namespace ' + namespace.group(1) + ';', 'namespace ' + new_ns + ';')
        if text != original or dest != p:
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_text(text)
            if dest != p:
                p.unlink()
for root in [src, base / 'tests/Unit']:
    for p in sorted(root.rglob('*'), key=lambda p: len(p.parts), reverse=True):
        if p.is_dir() and not any(p.iterdir()):
            p.rmdir()
Path('/tmp/docgen-moved-classes.json').write_text(json.dumps(changed, indent=2))
print(f'Moved {len(moves)} source classes and their tests; updated source, imports and coverage metadata.')
PY
